summary: Validate native effect providers against daemon-owned capabilities and park visible admission conflicts

replay.detail: Existing native-message receipts and origination fences are preserved.

schema.detail: No registry, corpus or database schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Native messages remain native-coordinated; unknown providers and mismatched class or target declarations are refused before admission.

recovery.detail: Visible operation conflicts park durably before sending; recovery never grants native-message origination authority.
